create_DatasetBase_from_h5_directory: create a DatasetBase instance that loads all h5 files from a directory for training neural net models
create_Trial_from_h5_group: create a Trial object from an HDF5 group to access temporal, config, and image keys
get_img_from_trial: get an image array from a Trial by key and index with optional depth or RGB normalization
get_conf_from_trial: get a config value from a Trial by key using the get_conf method
process_h5_files_with_DatasetBase: process a list of HDF5 files into trials using DatasetBase process_files method filtering by demo status
